name: Men's Carefree Unshrinkable Tee, Traditional Fit, Henley
description: Made of soft cotton that resists wrinkles, shrinking, fading and pilling, our resilient henley keeps its shape wash after wash.
key_features: 100% jersey-knit cotton; double ring-spun fabric fights shrinkage, wrinkles, fading and pilling.
Ribbed trim is 90% cotton/10% Lycra® elastane.
Traditional Fit: Relaxed through the chest, sleeve and waist.
Durable double-needle stitching; straight hem can be worn tucked or untucked.
Tagless printed label and soft jersey-knit neck taping for comfort.
